metadata.name: West Altadena spread-model scenario
metadata.label: Scenario input, not a forecast
metadata.generator: modeling/scripts/spread_model.py (wind-walk spread over OSM ground, spot fires)
metadata.basis: Shape and direction follow the published Eaton Fire progression into west Altadena, January 2025. Barriers come from OpenStreetMap. Timing and every rate are stated assumptions.
metadata.claim: Conservative within our assumptions. Not validated against satellite data.
metadata.ground: public/map/altadena.json: washes and water never burn; roads, parks, schools, parking, golf, pitches and cemeteries slow it; brush speeds it; some homes never catch
metadata.neverMarksSafe: Homes outside every front get an extrapolated arrival time, never 'safe'.
